description: Not everyone loves Imma Tataranni: she is forty-three years old and she has a brilliant intelligence, but she has a frank, direct and impulsive personality, sometimes too much for the male-dominated world of the prosecutor’s office in Matera. Strong, educated and firmly unconventional: it’s impossible not to notice her, and not only for her bright and extravagant outfits, but also for that attitude at work and at home - a real talent - of intelligence and stubbornness. Imma, is a champion in her field. Together with the trustworthy Calogiuri, a young and silent handsome man, she investigates a series of crimes that shake the region of Basilicata. Imma works hard to discover the truth in this amusing and cunning series, portrait of today’s Italy.
